checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Publish against a non-existent event group uuid must not crash
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 888 ('Invalid Parameters') from check_if_allowed_to_add_trade_to_event_group, which returns 888 when EventGroup.find_by(id: event_group_id, company_id: new_trade.company_id) is blank. No 5xx, no stage created.
steps: 1. POST /trade/template_input with an event_group_uuid that decodes to a non-existent id.
2. Assert a controlled 4xx and never a 500.
3. Assert no TradeRequest row is inserted.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; the referenced event group uuid does not resolve to any row in the caller's company.
checkResults.verdict: handled safely — refused cleanly (HTTP 422), no crash

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Create draft event group as the seed for an RFQ-only event
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 200; EventGroup created with status draft and precomputed_data.creator_fields.creator_quantity populated so EventGroupLineItem#quantity returns 10.0 and #unit_symbol returns 'Nos'.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with status draft and one line item quantity 10 Nos.
2. Assert HTTP 200 and capture the returned event group uuid.
3. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items and assert exactly one active/draft line item is returned.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser with create rights; {{productUuid}} and {{productQualityUuid}} are active in the caller's workspace.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Reject extending a deadline to a timestamp in the past
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with a numeric error code from update_event_group_data; the TradeSchedule end_time must not move backwards. An accepted past deadline would instantly close a live event.
steps: 1. Note the current end_time of the live stage.
2. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with an end_time epoch far in the past.
3. Assert the request is refused and the original end_time is unchanged on the trade_schedules row.
checkResults.preconditions: Event group {{eventGroupUuid}} is active and latest, with a live stage whose bidding window is currently open.
checkResults.verdict: ACCEPTED input that should have been rejected (HTTP 200)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Negative sealbid extension time must not be applied
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with a numeric error code. update_schedule(trade, time_extension_value:, time_extension_type: 'sealbid_extension_time') must reject a negative delta; TradeRequest#event_ending_at (max end_time across auction / dynamic_extra_time / sealbid_extension_time) must not shrink.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with sealbid_extension_time set to -3600.
2. Assert the request is refused with a numeric error code.
3. Assert the sealbid_extension_time TradeSchedule end_time is unchanged.
checkResults.preconditions: Event group {{eventGroupUuid}} is active and latest with a sealed-bid stage that has a sealbid_extension_time schedule.
checkResults.verdict: ACCEPTED input that should have been rejected (HTTP 200)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Deadline extension payload with a non-numeric duration must not crash
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx. Expected HTTP 422 with a numeric error code. Hazard: 'forever'.to_i is 0 in Ruby, which would silently write a zero-length dynamic_extra_time schedule instead of erroring.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with dynamic_extra_time set to the string 'forever'.
2. Assert a controlled 4xx and never a 500.
3. Assert no schedule row is written with a zero or null end_time.
checkResults.preconditions: Event group {{eventGroupUuid}} is active and latest.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Fetching a non-existent event group returns the project-not-found code
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 533 ('Project does not exist.'), rendered by Api::EventGroupsController#show via render_error_json(533) when EventGroup.find_by is blank. Same code the clone guard uses for a missing event.
steps: 1. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} using a uuid for a deleted or never-created event group.
2. Assert HTTP 422 with the documented numeric error code.
3. Assert the body contains no internal ids or backtrace.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; the requested uuid decodes to an id with no event_groups row.
checkResults.message: You are not authorized to perform this action
checkResults.verdict: rejected, but for a DIFFERENT reason — this check did not exercise what it claims. Expected "Project does not exist", got "You are not authorized to perform this action". Usually means a precondition (config or data) isn't met on this client, not a product bug.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Cross-tenant event group read must be refused, not served
checkResults.expectMessage: You are not authorized to perform this action
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 455 ('You are not authorized to perform this action'), 682 ('You are not allowed to view this project.') or 101 - never HTTP 200 with foreign data. Note the platform renders authorization failures as HTTP 422, not 403.
steps: 1. Obtain an event group uuid owned by another tenant.
2. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} authenticated as company A.
3. Assert the request is refused and that no title, line items, vendor names or stage data from company B appear in the body.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated as a purchaser of company A. {{eventGroupUuid}} belongs to company B and company A is not in Current.allowed_companies for it.
checkResults.message: You are not authorized to perform this action
checkResults.verdict: correctly rejected (422: You are not authorized to perform this action)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Unauthenticated event group read must be rejected at the auth layer
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 401 auth failure from the Api::ApiController authentication before_action. The request must not reach EventGroup.find_by and must not emit 533, 455 or any event payload.
steps: 1. Strip the Authorization header from the request.
2. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}.
3. Assert HTTP 401 and that the body contains no event data.
checkResults.preconditions: No Authorization header / no valid session token is sent with the request. A valid {{eventGroupUuid}} is used so only auth can be the reason for refusal.
checkResults.message: You are not authorized to perform this action
checkResults.verdict: correctly rejected (422: You are not authorized to perform this action)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Path traversal and encoded separators in the event group id segment
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 4xx (404 routing error or 422 with error code 533). The Rails router must not resolve the traversal to another action and Utils uuid decoding must not raise an unhandled exception.
steps: 1. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} where the substituted value is '..%2f..%2fadmin'.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx and never a 500 or a redirect to another controller.
3. Assert no file path, route list or backtrace is echoed.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser. The uuid placeholder is substituted with a traversal payload rather than a real uuid.
checkResults.message: You are not authorized to perform this action
checkResults.verdict: handled safely — refused cleanly (HTTP 422), no crash

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Reject publish-time edits against a superseded event group version
checkResults.expectMessage: You are not allowed to perform this action
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 101 ('You are not allowed to perform this action'), from render_error_json(101) unless event_group.latest? in Api::EventGroupsController#update. The superseded event_groups row keeps its original title.
steps: 1. Create a new version of the event group so the original is no longer latest.
2. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} against the now-superseded uuid.
3. Assert the request is refused and no attributes on the old version change.
checkResults.preconditions: Event group {{eventGroupUuid}} has been versioned (an amendment exists) so EventGroup#latest? returns false for this uuid.
checkResults.verdict: ACCEPTED input that should have been rejected (HTTP 200)

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Reject auction stage creation with a missing auction_config
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with a numeric error code (2 'Insufficient parameters' or 888 'Invalid Parameters'). No auction TradeRequest is created with auction_config null, since the enum {rank:0, price:1, rank_and_price:2, traffic_light:3, knockout:4, dutch:5, book_building:6} drives the whole bidding UI.
steps: 1. POST /trade/template_input with rfx_mode auction and no auction_config key at all.
2. Assert the request is refused with a numeric error code.
3. Assert no TradeRequest with rfx_mode auction and a null auction_config is persisted.
checkResults.preconditions: Draft event group {{eventGroupUuid}} exists with line items; no auction stage exists yet.
checkResults.verdict: rejected, but for a DIFFERENT reason — this check did not exercise what it claims. Expected "Insufficient parameters", got "Order not active". Usually means a precondition (config or data) isn't met on this client, not a product bug.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Auction stage creation with an auction_config outside the enum
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 4xx (422 with error code 2 or 888). No ArgumentError from the auction_config enum leaking as a 500; trade_requests row count unchanged.

2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx and never a 500.
3. Assert no auction stage is persisted for {{eventGroupUuid}}.
checkResults.preconditions: Draft event group {{eventGroupUuid}} exists with line items.
checkResults.verdict: handled safely — refused cleanly (HTTP 422), no crash

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Reject a second RFQ stage of the same rfx_mode on a published event
checkResults.expectMessage: Same type of event already exists for this Project
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 830 ('Same type of event already exists for this Project.') raised by check_if_allowed_to_add_trade_to_event_group when old_tr_with_same_rfx_mode is present and is_new_stage_addition is false. No second RFQ TradeRequest is inserted.

checkResults.preconditions: Event group {{eventGroupUuid}} is published (active) and already owns one TradeRequest with rfx_mode rfq in status active/closed/scheduled/draft.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_SQL injection payload in rfx_mode on RFQ stage creation
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 4xx (422 expected) with a numeric error code; no 5xx, no SQL fragment or backtrace echoed. trade_requests table still exists and its row count is unchanged.
steps: 1. POST /trade/template_input with rfx_mode set to a SQL injection string.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx, never a 500 and never a raw ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid message.
3. Re-query GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} and confirm the event group and its stages are untouched.
checkResults.preconditions: Draft event group {{eventGroupUuid}} exists; a baseline count of trade_requests rows is recorded.
checkResults.verdict: handled safely — refused cleanly (HTTP 422), no crash
